svg.text: THE JOURNEY OF ONE DERO TRANSACTION
From your wallet → through the network → into the encrypted ledger (DLT) → confirmation back to you. Follow the numbers 1 → 14.
1 · YOU want to send DERO (or use a dApp)
You open your wallet — CLI, GUI, web or mobile — enter an amount, or open a
💡 You tap ‘Send’, like a banking app — but there’s no bank, and nobody can see the amount.
2 · WALLET builds a sealed envelope (≈25 ms)
Picks a ring of 8 accounts (yours + 7 decoys) · hides the amount with homomorphic encryption + a
Pedersen commitment · attaches six bound zero-knowledge proofs (ring, range, balance…) · optional
💡 The app wraps your payment in unbreakable math — identity and amount sealed, even from the network.
3 · WALLET signs with your private key
Your key authorizes the tx on your device and never leaves
it. Nobody can tell which of the 8 ring accounts is really
💡 Only your key can approve a payment. It never leaves your phone
The wallet hands the tx to your daemon over local RPC. Quick checks:
💡 Your node = the post office that sends your envelope on its way.
5 · YOUR NODE adds it to the mempool
The pool of unconfirmed transactions, shared with every peer.
💡 The waiting room. Your tx waits for a miner to pick it up.
Nodes gossip the tx over TLS-encrypted connections (P2P port 10101). Within seconds, every
💡 A secret whisper spreads through the crowd — everyone hears it, the message stays sealed.
Each node checks signature, zero-knowledge proofs and balance — computed on the ENCRYPTED
data (homomorphic math) — plus the double-spend check. ≈25 ms.
💡 Every node checks your sealed envelope without ever opening it. Anything wrong → rejected.
CPU-only, memory-hard puzzle. ASIC/GPU-resistant → any PC can
💡 A CPU lottery. The winner writes the next page of the notebook —
9 · MINERS pack the block & earn rewards
Verified txs are packed into a block — 9 fast mini-blocks + 1
final (10 per block, one every ~2 sec), so up to 10 miners
💡 Your envelope is now on the winning page — part of the official
Erasure-coded into 48 chunks; any 16 rebuild the whole block. All nodes
re-validate before accepting. Consensus: one agreed chain.
💡 The page is shredded into confetti — anyone with 16 pieces can rebuild and
Balances settle by homomorphic addition/subtraction on ciphertext — never decrypted, ever.
Just 66 bytes per account. Smart contracts (DVM · DeroScript) update encrypted state too.
💡 The notebook is updated. Your balance changed — but the number is still invisible to everyone but
Blocks are chained and merkle-proved. Supply stays auditable (hard cap
≈20.89M DERO). History can be pruned to a few GB. The past cannot be
💡 What’s written stays written. No erasers on this notebook.
After a few 18-second blocks, your tx is
confirmed. Your wallet reads the encrypted
balance and decrypts it locally with your key.
💡 The network agrees — your app shows the new
💡 balance. Only your app can read it.
Prove ‘I sent exactly X’ without revealing
your identity or balance. dApps see their
💡 A receipt that shows the total — but not your
Your money never leaves your control. The network never sees your amount, your identity, or your balance — it only agrees, in math,
that everything adds up. That is how DERO replaces banks, clouds and databases with one shared, private, tamper-proof notebook.
